bugs.what: Told Keeper Wren 'you've not reached Rowan yet' even though I had already met and fully talked with Keeper Rowan at the Understory in Thornwold much earlier in the playthrough — the game didn't recognize that cross-reference and gave a generic 'she'll keep' response instead of resolving the linked quest.
bugs.where: Hollowbrook / The Keepers' Hall, talking to Keeper Wren

bugs.what: Several 'settle the dispute between companions' will checks had quietly escalating DCs and no visible bonus preview before committing, leading to failed attempts that cost standing with two companions at once despite reasonably high will scores.
bugs.where: various companion dispute prompts (e.g. Tamsin/Osk, Tamsin/Vell)

confusions: Early on it wasn't clear whether the game enforced a companion-party cap; I kept recruiting (ended with 4) and was never told if that was a soft or hard limit.
Wilderness navigation via numbered stands/compass directions occasionally felt disorienting until using the free 'get your bearings' action, which wasn't always offered in every room.

The reeve/priest 'barrow doors' conflict (seal vs open) wasn't clearly explained as compatible-if-you-decline-the-promise until the priest's dialogue spelled it out — a first-time player could easily lock themselves into one faction accidentally.
suggestions: Surface an explicit companion-capacity indicator (e.g. 'party 4/4') so players know if/when recruiting more is possible.
Show the current DC/odds before a 'settle the dispute' will check the same way explicit skill checks do, so players can decide whether to risk double-standing-loss.
Let 'ask about X' dialogue options recognize when the player already independently discovered the answer elsewhere, rather than replying as if it's still unknown.
